adjudication.rationale: In `admin_group_route.js`, the previous `afterModel` returned `model.findMembers().then(...)`, so a rejected members-load promise would participate in the route’s promise chain. The new `setupController` calls `model.findMembers();` but does not return/chain the promise, so failures from `Discourse.ajax('/groups/.../members.json'...)` in `Group#findMembers` will not be caught by Ember route error handling tied to the transition and can become unhandled/reported differently.
